verdict.rationale: First-party docs show PDF and many other file types can be uploaded, with per-source limits of 500,000 words or 200MB. You can chat over those sources with grounded inline citations that jump to the quoted passage, pick which sources to use, and generate reports, study guides and briefings from them. Community users confirm it is useful for structured research and holds a lot of context. Missing for 10: documented limits on corpus scale (number of sources per notebook), independent hands-on corroboration of retrieval and citation accuracy over a large research corpus.
